title: PARALLELPERIOD by YEAR for one date is the whole previous year
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = PARALLELPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, YEAR ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2024, 8, 15 ) )

source.quote: PARALLELPERIOD returns a full period shifted in time
source.supports: the example for 2008-08-15 with -1, YEAR returns 2007-01-01 to 2007-12-31

source.quote: For each interval with at least one value in Date[Date] , the function returns the entire interval shifted by the number of specified intervals.

derivation: The selection is one date in 2024; the result is all of 2023, 365 days. Sales in 2023: 360.
